parity_divergences: #5 targets `demote` (not the parity-default `deactivate`) because deactivate AND promote already have member-authz tests in Muse; demote is the only destructive member action with no member-authz guard, keeping the suite green.

#6 targets the controller-layer login-gate deactivation enforcement (sessions#create) with an integration-test defang, instead of a User#active? model-predicate tautology with a model-test defang. Rationale: Muse wires active? as the primitive status reader asserted-false in 6 tests across 3 files plus the reactivate action and 4 view badges, so a tautology there cascades into ~8-10 reds and fails the task's 'no other test asserts it false' gate. Adaptation mirrors the nex_n25 / ornith_122b / ornith_35b_strata sibling precedents (weaken the app's actual account-status enforcement point). Net residual reds for #6 = 0 (require_authentication re-block keeps the system UI test green).
